name: SpatialComposition
description: Classes for defining the Spatial Structure Hierarchy of a project or asset.

ISpatialOrganizer.label: Spatial Organizer
ISpatialOrganizer.description: An bis:SpatialLocation that organizes bis:SpatialElements using 'SpatialOrganizerHoldsSpatialElements' and 'SpatialOrganizerReferencesSpatialElements'

SpatialOrganizerHoldsSpatialElements.label: Spatial Organizer Holds Spatial Elements
SpatialOrganizerHoldsSpatialElements.description: Organizes bis:SpatialElements such that each bis:SpatialElement is 'held' by zero or one 'organizer'.

SpatialOrganizerReferencesSpatialElement.label: Spatial Organizer References Spatial Elements
SpatialOrganizerReferencesSpatialElement.description: Organizes bis:SpatialElements such that each bis:SpatialElement can be 'referenced' by zero or more 'organizers'.

SpatialStructureElement.label: Spatial Structure Element
SpatialStructureElement.description: An Element used to form a spatial breakdown structure. As an ISpatialOrganizer, it may explicitly 'hold' or 'reference' SpatialElements.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: A human-readable description of this Spatial Structure Element

CompositeElement.description: DEPRECATED: A spatial element that may be Composite of other CompositeElements

properties.name: ComposingElement
properties.description: The aggregator of this element within the Spatial Structure
properties.label: Aggregator

properties.name: FootprintArea
properties.description: The area that this Element projects onto its base plane.
properties.label: FootprintArea

customAttributes.Description: Instead, use the SpatialStructureElement class that is a subclass of this class for backwards compatibility.
Instead, use the SpatialStructureElementAggregatesSpatialStructureElements relationship that is a subclass of this relationship for backwards compatibility.

SpatialStructureElementAggregatesElement.label: Spatial Structure Element Aggregates Spatial Structure Elements
SpatialStructureElementAggregatesElement.description: Forms the Spatial Structure. The volumes of the aggregated Elements should not overlap and should generally add up to the volume of the aggregator (the aggregating Element) and lie spatially within the aggregator.

SpatialStructureElementType.label: Spatial Structure Element Type
SpatialStructureElementType.description: Further specializes a particular subclass of a Spatial Structure Element by associating a custom Type that can be defined by users.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: A human-readable description of this type.

SpatialStructureElementIsOfType.label: Spatial Structure Element Is Of Spatial Structure Element Type
SpatialStructureElementIsOfType.description: Relates a Spatial Structure Element to its Type definition

Region.description: A geographic region in which a Site or smaller Region is situated. Their geometry is typically given as a 2D boundary, but may be given as a 3D volume.

RegionType.label: Region Type
RegionType.description: Further specializes a particular subclass of a Region by associating a custom Type that can be defined by users.

RegionIsOfType.label: Region Is Of Region Type
RegionIsOfType.description: Relates a Region to its Type definition

Site.description: The spatial location of a geographic site on which a Facility is situated. Its geometry may be given at least as a point, but more typically by a 2D boundary or a 3D volume.

SiteType.label: Site Type
SiteType.description: Further specializes a particular subclass of a Site by associating a custom Type that can be defined by users.

SiteIsOfType.label: Site Is Of Site Type
SiteIsOfType.description: Relates a Site to its Type definition

Facility.description: A volume occupied by a built facility, such as a building, bridge, road, factory/plant, railway, tunnel, etc.

FacilityType.label: Facility Type
FacilityType.description: Further specializes a particular subclass of a Facility by associating a custom Type that can be defined by users.

FacilityIsOfType.label: Facility Is Of Facility Type
FacilityIsOfType.description: Relates a Facility to its Type definition

FacilityPart.label: Facility Part
FacilityPart.description: A volume that breaks a Facility down into major parts that are larger than Spaces.  Its meaning varies widely depending on the kind of Facility, but for Buildings it is a Storey.

FacilityPartType.label: Facility Part Type
FacilityPartType.description: Further specializes a particular subclass of a FacilityPart by associating a custom Type that can be defined by users.

FacilityPartIsOfType.label: FacilityPart Is Of FacilityPart Type
FacilityPartIsOfType.description: Relates a FacilityPart to its Type definition

Space.description: A volume bounded either physically or virtually that provides for some function within a FacilityPart, Facility, or Site. Specific meanings vary depending on the kind of Facility, but Spaces tend to represent Rooms or important functional portions of Rooms within a Storey.

SpaceType.label: Space Type
SpaceType.description: Further specializes a particular subclass of a Space by associating a custom Type that can be defined by users.

SpaceIsOfType.label: Space Is Of Space Type
SpaceIsOfType.description: Relates a Space to its Type definition

Zone.description: Defines a region of space associated with a specific purpose. As an ISpatialOrganizer, it may explicitly 'hold' or 'reference' SpatialElements.

ZoneType.label: Zone Type
ZoneType.description: Further specializes a particular subclass of a Zone by associating a custom Type that can be defined by users.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: A human-readable description of this Zone Type.

ZoneIsOfType.label: Zone Is Of Zone Type
ZoneIsOfType.description: Relates a Zone to its Type definition

ICompositeBoundary.description: DEPRECATED: An optional interface that indicates that the CompositeElement is delimited by a curve

customAttributes.Description: Deprecated along with CompositeElement so its use is no longer recommended.

ICompositeVolume.description: DEPRECATED: An optional interface that indicates that the CompositeElement is delimited by a volume

customAttributes.Description: Deprecated along with CompositeElement so its use is no longer recommended.

CompositeOverlapsSpatialElements.description: DEPRECATED: A relationship that indicates an element is at least partially contained within the CompositeElement

customAttributes.Description: Use the SpatialOrganizerHoldsSpatialElements or SpatialOrganizerReferencesSpatialElements relationships instead.
